text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even after concocting all those strategies and challenging them...
I lost, plain and simple. How pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aargh... I'm totally useless, aren't I...?
I'm so demoralized... Maybe I should just quit.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's go for the win.
Let's take what we've learned and rework our strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Next time...? 
After pullin' a cringey move like that, is there even gonna be a next time for me?
choice_data_list: As many times as it takes, I'll prepare the board for you.
As many times as it takes, I'll prepare the board for you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're... are you serious?
Why go that far...?
choice_data_list: Because I believe in Ruler's talent.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah... this is bad. Terribly bad...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If you go that far to say so,
how could I not answer your call?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I'll definitely make you watch.
I'll make you see me conquer the board in style, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I already told you I'm quitting~!
choice_data_list: You wouldn't just give up on the game... would you?
You wouldn't just throw the game away... right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, there are countless things I need to reflect on from today.
That's precisely why I want to give this a try.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With this new offensive strategy,
let's see just how far I can go.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...I hate looking lame, but staying lame is even worse.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'll do it. Using defeat as nourishment, next time—I will seize victory without fail.
